g.text: Class Diagram (Design) - AA01 Local Accounts and Authentication
History API updates the pathname without reloading.
The recovery query is read on load.
AuthProvider state and screen state select the other views.
App passes props down and handles callbacks from views.
AA04 owns the session lifecycle and logout.
REST/JSON via fetch · bearer header · error mapping
